title: hieracium maculatum subsp. tinctum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. tinctum, commonly known as spotted hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. tinctum include treating digestive issues, relieving pain and fever, and supporting immune function, due to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to confirm its safety and efficacy for human consumption.
